subject: Publisher setup: SKU catalog alignment + marketplace account identity gap
messages:
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@contoso.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Marketplace Onboarding <marketplace-onboard@microsoft.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace publish kickoff — identity & SKU questions

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the quick intro call yesterday. Contoso is ready to move ahead with the Azure Marketplace listing but we hit a couple of gaps on our side with publisher identity proofing and SKU mapping. Before we start publishing, could you confirm the following from Redwood's side:

- Which publisher identity (company/legal entity) will appear on the Azure offer listing?
- Do you support multiple SKUs for our tiered packaging (Starter / Business / Enterprise) and a single offer manifest?
- We'll need the technical manifest draft to validate SSO/ARM-related entries — can you share a sample?

I'd like to keep marketplace-onboard@microsoft.com looped for technical validation.

Thanks,
Jane
Product Partnerships - Contoso
[Attachment: contoso_requirements.docx (DOCX, 28KB)]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@contoso.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marketplace Onboarding <marketplace-onboard@microsoft.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace publish kickoff — identity & SKU questions

Hi Jane — great to hear. Short answers up front:

- Publisher identity: Redwood Inference will be the publisher on the public offer; Contoso can be listed as the co-seller and referenced in the offer description. For legal identity proofs (tax, DUNS, etc.) we can either use Redwood's account or submit Contoso as a linked reseller — we'll need to confirm which method Contoso prefers.
- SKUs: Yes, Azure supports multiple SKUs under one offer. We typically map each product tier to a SKU id in the manifest.
- Manifest sample: attaching a draft manifest and a sample SKU mapping CSV for your product team to review.

Next steps I propose: Camila will coordinate the manifest fields we must populate for Contoso's SSO/ARM integration. Alex can handle the technical gate checklist for the portal submission.

-Rafael
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: manifest_draft.json (JSON, 9KB)]

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@contoso.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Marketplace Onboarding <marketplace-onboard@microsoft.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace publish kickoff — identity & SKU questions

Thanks — looping in the checklist and a proposed SKU mapping so Contoso can confirm names and billing descriptors. A few operational notes: 

1) Identity proofing options:
   - Option A (fast): Redwood publishes under Redwood Inference; Contoso listed as co-seller. Requires Contoso to sign a co-sell addendum (we can use DocuSign).
   - Option B (preferred by some partners): Contoso provides publisher proofs and we add Contoso as the primary publisher. This adds ~3-5 business days to onboarding.

2) SKU naming guidance: avoid special characters, keep short IDs (e.g., contoso-starter, contoso-business, contoso-enterprise). These IDs become part of the ARM resource paths.

3) SSO/ARM validation: we need the Contoso tenant ID and a test SPN with reader scope to validate the ARM hooks. If that's a blocker, we can do a stubbed manifest for the publish gate and complete the SSO settings in parallel.

Attached: sku_mapping_v1.csv (sample mapping), publisher_agreement_signed.pdf (redacted copy).

Camila Reyes
Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sku_mapping_v1.csv (CSV, 4KB)]
[Attachment: publisher_agreement_signed.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Jane Doe <jane.doe@contoso.com>
Date: Tue, 3 May 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace publish kickoff — identity & SKU questions

Quick technical clarifications:

- Manifest fields we will populate: offerId, publisherId, planId (per SKU), planDisplayName, armTemplateLink, termsLink, privacyLink, and images. I'll provide an example armTemplateLink that points to a container we control for ARM artifacts.
- Regarding SSO: for initial validation we only need the tenant ID and a test user; the SPN only needs Reader on a dedicated test subscription — do not give contributor access.
- For co-sell readiness, Microsoft also requires a proof-of-deployment entry (we can submit a small smoke test script and results).

I'll attach a short checklist for the portal technical gate.

-Alex
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: portal_tech_gate_checklist.pdf (PDF, 22KB)]

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@contoso.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Marketplace Onboarding <marketplace-onboard@microsoft.com>
Date: Wed, 4 May 2027 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace publish kickoff — identity & SKU questions

Thanks team — this is helpful. A few follow-ups from Contoso: 

- Contoso prefers Option A (Redwood publishes; Contoso as co-seller) to keep timelines tight. We'll sign the co-sell addendum via DocuSign today.
- I'll send over the tenant ID and create a test user with Reader later today (expect that to arrive by EOD).
- On SKU ids: we like your contoso-starter/business/enterprise pattern; we'll confirm display names by EOD.

Appreciate the attachments — will review manifest and checklist and report any gaps.

Best,
Jane
Product Partnerships - Contoso
[Attachment: co-sell_addendum_signed.docx (DOCX, 18KB)]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@contoso.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 May 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace publish kickoff — identity & SKU questions

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround, Jane. Summary / next steps (owners):

- Contoso: send tenant ID + test user (Jane) — due EOD 2027-05-04 (Status: incoming)
- Contoso: confirm SKU display names (Jane) — due 2027-05-04 (Status: pending)
- Camila: prepare DocuSign co-sell envelope + upload signed addendum to Drive (Camila) — due 2027-05-04 (Status: in progress)
- Alex: finalize portal_tech_gate_checklist and provide ARM artifact container URL (Alex) — due 2027-05-05
- Rafael: schedule the validation window with Microsoft onboarding to run once we have tenant ID (Rafael) — target 2027-05-07

I'll schedule a 30-minute sync with Contoso and Microsoft onboarding for Friday morning PT to walk the manifest and SSO steps. If anyone sees a blocker, call it out here.

Thanks all — Rafael
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: meeting_invite.ics (iCal, 2KB)]
